name: rhongomiant-spellshroud-opponent-spell-finds-no-target
notes: Rhongomiant, Grove's Spire (clS3E0HrZL, EXALTED/NORM WARRIOR REGALIA/WEAPON): "Spellshroud (Objects with spellshroud can't be targeted by spells.)" -- the first, unconditional keyword; only its two [Mordred Bonus] clauses are conditional. Player 2 plays Fracturize ("Target item or weapon ...") on its own turn while Rhongomiant is the only item/weapon on the board: the spell finds no legal target (no prompt), resolves, and Rhongomiant is untouched. Replaces the formerly pinned rhongomiant-spellshroud-spell-can-still-target-it, which asserted the buggy outcome.

rulesClauses: Spellshroud: objects with spellshroud can't be targeted by spells.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Rhongomiant's printed Spellshroud was not implemented: a spell could target it. HasSpellshroud() (Custom/GameLogic.php) recognised printed Spellshroud only through a hard-coded card-ID list and HasKeyword_Spellshroud(), which is never generated (function_exists is false), and clS3E0HrZL was in neither, so FilterSpellshroudTargets() kept Rhongomiant in the target list. Evidence on HEAD a1f72a1c (pinned by the old rhongomiant-spellshroud-spell-can-still-target-it fixture, now removed): player 2's Fracturize target prompt was 'MZCHOOSE:theirField-1' (player 1's Rhongomiant) and choosing it replaced the weapon with a Cleric Fractal phantasia override. Fix: HasSpellshroud() returns true for clS3E0HrZL (after the HasNoAbilities / NO_SPELLSHROUD gates).
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php HasSpellshroud() (no entry for clS3E0HrZL; no generated HasKeyword_Spellshroud table)
